hooks._doc: Refuse to write to docs/_archive/, refuse to delete AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md hardlink, refuse to drop the docs frontmatter on .md files. Exit 2 = block.
After every AI write, run biome format on staged JS/TS and lint-docs on changed .md. Non-blocking: warnings are surfaced in chat.
When the AI turn ends, remind the operator if verify:q / lint-docs would still catch something. Informational only.
